figures.caption: Figure 5: Example of unspecified behavior: the order of evaluation of function arguments is unspecified by the C standard, and the two toolchains pick different orders. (a) shows the minimal reproducer, (b) displays the native C execution where second() is evaluated first, and (c) illustrates the Wasm execution via Node.js where first() is evaluated first.

Figure 1: Example Native-Wasm discrepancy: Calling mmap on a zero-length file triggers a JavaScript glue code crash that never happens under native execution. (a) shows the minimal reproducer, (b) displays the native C execution, and (c) illustrates the Wasm execution via Node.js.
Figure 3: Fix rate with respect to inference budget (USD). Across all evaluated LLMs, WasmMend (blue) consistently achieves the highest fix rate under equivalent budget constraints in most cases.
